summary: Implementation plan for elevating the Hero section to flagship editorial caliber: (1) Open borderless 3D Editorial Desk stage that blends into the Hero backdrop with a whisper-quiet floating HUD pill, (2) Typography upgrade from Instrument Serif/Inter to Fraunces + Plus Jakarta Sans + JetBrains Mono, and (3) Replacing the boilerplate SVG icons in the Hero social proof avatars with bespoke editorial monogram/portrait medallions.
